name: Why is my water heater leaking?

mainEntity.name: Why is my water heater leaking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water heaters can leak for several reasons, including a loose drain valve, a corroded tank, a faulty temperature and pressure (T&P) relief valve, or a leak in the plumbing connections. Minor issues like a loose valve can often be tightened, while a corroded tank typically requires replacement. Identifying the source of the leak is crucial to determine the correct repair or replacement action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common causes of water heater leaks include a loose drain valve, corroded tank, faulty T&P valve, or plumbing connection issues. The source determines if repair or replacement is needed.
